newsitem.title: SPAIN: Italy's Prodi sure Euro will be launched on time.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi sure Euro will be launched on time.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said he was convinced that Europe's single currency project would be launched without delays in 1999.

"I'm sure it will happen (in 1999), because now that we are embarked upon the course I can't imagine the possibility of making changes without causing severe damage," Prodi said in an interview published on Sunday in the Spanish newspaper El Pais.
Italian financial markets dropped sharply on Friday on fears the single currency launch might be postponed.
"In any case, Italy can't ask for delays or changes in conditions. We can only honour our obligations," Prodi said.
On domestic matters, Prodi said he would not run for re-election.

"I went into politics because I thought my country was in grave danger and because I think it is a country with a great future. My contract with the Italian electorate lasts one legislative period and not one day more."
